platform_rule: Azure generates. COBIT-Chain evaluates. Azure deploys. COBIT-Chain provides evidence for trust.
positioning: This is not a separate cloud architecture product. It strengthens Platform A by evaluating AI-generated infrastructure before deployment.

stages.ai_generated_output: Business requirements, workload purpose, environment target, user groups, operational goals, and compliance assumptions.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluate whether the generated infrastructure intent is clear, bounded, owned, and aligned to regulated operational context.

stages.ai_generated_output: Recommended cloud architecture pattern, services, networking approach, security posture, monitoring model, and deployment sequence.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluate whether the recommendation is traceable to intent, explains assumptions, avoids unsupported design claims, and identifies limitations.

stages.ai_generated_output: Subscription layout, management groups, identity model, network segmentation, resource organization, governance baseline, and environment structure.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluate whether the landing zone supports secure, governed, observable, and operationally maintainable deployment.

stages.ai_generated_output: Bicep, Terraform, ARM, pipeline templates, parameter files, deployment modules, resource definitions, and configuration code.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluate whether generated IaC is traceable, reviewed, versioned, testable, policy-aligned, and safe for controlled deployment.

stages.ai_generated_output: Policy assignments, guardrails, compliance rules, tagging policies, allowed locations, resource constraints, and deployment controls.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluate whether generated policies are appropriate, enforceable, tested, aligned to the workload, and evidenced before deployment.

stages.ai_generated_output: Identity controls, secrets design, firewall rules, network controls, encryption settings, privileged access model, and threat assumptions.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluate whether generated security controls support least privilege, traceability, secrets protection, network control, and risk-based approval.

stages.ai_generated_output: Architecture documentation, generated design package, IaC summary, policy package, security notes, and deployment recommendation.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Ensure a named accountable human reviews, challenges, approves, rejects, or requests revision before deployment.

stages.ai_generated_output: Deployment pipeline, release workflow, environment promotion, approval gates, rollback mechanism, and deployment logs.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluate whether deployment is controlled, authorized, traceable, monitored, reversible, and aligned to change control.

stages.ai_generated_output: Monitoring dashboards, alerts, diagnostics, logs, health metrics, compliance signals, and operations documentation.
stages.cobitchain_assurance_role: Evaluate whether the deployed infrastructure remains observable, supportable, auditable, and operationally trustworthy over time.
